{{external|rs=Attack rate}} '''Attack speed''' is determined by the interval between hits. Hit intervals are measured in game ticks (''0.6 seconds''). '''The lower the interval, the faster the attack speed.''' The attack speed can not be altered by any consumables, rather it is determined by the type of weapon being used. The tables below show the attack speeds for the respective types. The speed of all combat [[spells]] is 5 (3.0 seconds). [[Powered staves]] (except for [[Tumeken's shadow]] and the [[Eye of Ayak]]) and the [[Harmonised Nightmare staff]] have an attack speed of 4 (2.4 seconds). Attack speed works similar to a global cooldown, where once you've activated that cooldown using 1 type of attack, you have to wait for that attacks cooldown to finish before another attack is possible. For example, if you attack with a 7 tick weapon such as the [[Crystal halberd]], then immediately switch to a 4 tick weapon such as an [[Abyssal tentacle]], you will have to wait 7 ticks between the two attacks. ==Weapon attack speeds== ===Melee weapons=== {| class="wikitable sortable align-center-2 align-center-3" !Weapon ![[File:Attack Speed icon.png|link=]]

|9 ticks (5.4s) |8 ticks (4.8s) |} {{Notelist}} ==Monster attack speeds== The attack speed of a [[monster]] determines the rate of attack of a monster in certain situations. This is a factor which balances the attacking power of a monster. The speed at which monsters attack is expressed in [[tick]]s (each tick lasting 0.6 seconds), which represents the delay between attacks. If a monster is left to attack uninterrupted, this delay defines the interval of the monster's attacks. A monster with a low delay between attacks will attack more frequently. Additionally, the attack speed of a monster determines when they will retaliate after your attack against them. The amount of ticks is equal to their attack speed halved, plus 1, rounded up. For example, a 4-tick attack speed means they will attack you back 3 ticks after your hit to initiate combat with them. {| class="wikitable" |- !Attack speed !Examples !Notes |- |1 tick (0.6 seconds)||[[Scarab swarm]], [[Pestilent Bloat]], [[Koschei the Deathless]] (form 4)||Hits low, but often.
